proposal.summary: Reporter observed the desktop client sometimes sends requests to an unrecognized address at startup and could not determine whether personal data is included.

AV.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request additional information and diagnostic data from the reporter (client version, exact timestamp, network capture or logs showing the request, destination address, request headers/payload) and attempt to reproduce in a controlled environment.

evidence_quotes.claim: Client sends requests to an unrecognized address at startup
evidence_quotes.quote: sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up.

evidence_quotes.claim: Reporter uncertain whether personal data is included
evidence_quotes.quote: I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included, but it seemed unusual, so I wanted to report it to your security team for review.
